title: alchemilla pubescens var. plicata
intro: Alchemilla pubescens var. plicata, commonly known as the Alpine Lady's Mantle, is a perennial plant species in the Rosaceae family. This plant is known for its medicinal properties and is used in traditional herbal medicine to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Alchemilla pubescens var. plicata include its anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antihistamine properties, which can be used to treat skin irritations, wounds, and allergies. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and glycosides, which exhibit therapeutic actions such as soothing, protecting, and calming the skin and mucous membranes.
